# Credits: the compressed test models

Made by `make.mjs` beside this file (milestone 25, check HL4), from
Khronos's glTF Sample Assets at commit
edc7c9e67c639d230715049ee31f9a96a6babbbe
(https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets). Each download's
SHA-256 is in `sums.json`.

- `draco-box.gltf`, `draco-box.bin`, `broken-draco.gltf`,
  `broken-draco.bin`: "Box" (glTF-Draco), © 2017 Cesium, CC BY 4.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The broken copy has
  its compressed data turned over.
- `meshopt-box.glb`: "Box" (glTF-Binary), © 2017 Cesium, CC BY 4.0,
  compressed with glTF Transform 4.5.1 (`gltf-transform meshopt`).
- `ktx2-box.gltf`, `ktx2-box.bin`: "Box Textured" (glTF), © 2017 Cesium,
  CC BY 4.0, its picture changed to the one below.
- `ktx2-box.ktx2`: `carbonfiber_normal.ktx2` (a carbon-fibre picture)
  of "Chronograph Watch" (glTF-KTX-BasisU), © 2025 Darmstadt Graphics
  Group GmbH, CC BY 4.0.
